body:
Chairman and CEO at Microsoft

Just wrapped our earnings call. It was a fast start to our fiscal year. Microsoft Cloud revenue surpassed $63B, with growth accelerating to 30% YoY. Lots of innovation as we build the new tech stack for the agentic wave. A few highlights: First, we announced our biggest update to Copilot to date, bringing together Chat, Cowork, Autopilot, and Code into one unified experience: • Daily users grew nearly 50% QoQ, and more than 5X YoY. • User satisfaction improved nearly 20% QoQ to another all-time high • Number of customers with more than 50K Copilot seats, up 8X YoY Great momentum with GitHub Copilot too, including Copilot Fusion, announced just this morning, which delivers frontier level quality, at up to 77% lower cost. And this is just the beginning. The next frontier is maximizing intelligence per task while continuously optimizing for cost and performance. This is the frontier that will matter to companies! And we are extending our vision of Copilot as the new OS for work, bringing the business logic and capabilities of D365 directly into Copilot, helping every organization stand up their own infinite SaaS factory. Second, underneath our 1P experiences is a common platform, starting with Foundry, which is becoming an increasingly important driver of our growth: • Foundry revenue more than tripled YoY • Number of customers building with multiple models grew 5X YoY • Revenue from open source models increased 10X YoY We're also bringing Foundry and Fabric closer together, so customers can build agents right next to their data. And with Microsoft IQ, we're making the rich enterprise context underneath Microsoft 365 + Foundry + Fabric available to agentic workloads. Nearly 60K customers are accessing context across Microsoft IQ, up 25% QoQ. Third, we’re also helping customers secure and govern their agents at scale. Over 50M agents are now in A365, up 30% QoQ. We are also bringing together Windows + Agent 365 so agents can work within secure boundaries on-device…

Then whats the need for 60000 employees being laid off? Is more Profitability better than Loyalty or Humanity or Compassion?

Appreciate the data! Though comparing Max to Max is a bit like comparing two fully loaded vans when most people just need to get to work. 😅 In practice, Claude Code with Opus at medium effort is often plenty for building a moderately complex web app or reviewing drafts when fine-tuning an open source AI model. And can be quite competitive with Codex Max for those tasks. The real question isn’t which model wins at maximum settings, but which delivers the best results per dollar for your actual workload.

If UK South wasn't almost impossible to deploy any sizable zone redundant solution to these days your cloud business would probably be growing faster!

I don't get this. Why publish something that show your success over so many people misery? Do you really get a kick out of this? What happened to empathy that you once pitched?

The biggest opportunity might be making powerful AI affordable for smaller businesses, not just enterprises. Better performance matters, but accessible pricing could change who actually benefits from these tools.

Satya Nadella What excites me most is the emergence of the "infinite SaaS factory" concept. For decades, enterprises adapted their processes to software. With Copilot, Foundry, and Fabric coming together, we're moving toward software adapting to each enterprise's unique processes. That shift could be as transformative as the move to cloud computing itself.

I think governance and context are becoming foundational layers of enterprise AI. Intelligence alone isn't enough for large organizations.

Sir, not only is this chart wrong in 17 ways and proves how asinine it is to rely on AI Slop, but we are also all now dumber as a species by having seen it. I award you zero points, and may god have mercy on your soul.

Satya Nadella . Great work with Microsoft! I really appreciate your inspiration in changing the culture from a "know it all" culture to a "learn it all" culture. But while I agree with the broader points of your post, I think there's still a bit of a gap between AI integration and the quality of the output. Copilot, for example, continues to struggle with producing polished, executive level PowerPoint presentations, despite PowerPoint being a Microsoft application. Interoperability between Microsoft apps has been an age-old issue for Microsoft that persists even now through the era of AI. That suggests there's still a bit of work to be done before these tools can consistently deliver at the level business leaders expect. Nevertheless, I believe you're a true inspiration for leaders across the U.S.!

This chart tells the whole story. For the last year, the debate was "Which coding agent is smartest?" - looking at the left side of the chart (Claude Code). Now the debate has shifted to "Which agent is smartest PER DOLLAR?" - and that's the green quadrant. GitHub Copilot Fusion hitting that sweet spot of high index + low cost per task is why we are seeing 5X YoY growth in Copilot users. Cost is becoming the real moat. Great visualization from Artificial Analysis.
